import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime type
data['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(data['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate the total spending
data['Total_Spending'] = data['MntWines'] + data['MntFruits'] + data['MntMeatProducts'] + data['MntFishProducts'] + data['MntSweetProducts'] + data['MntGoldProds']

# Create a segmented spending analysis plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Marital_Status', y='Total_Spending', data=data, palette='pastel')
plt.title('Customer Spending by Marital Status')
plt.xlabel('Marital Status')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime type
data['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(data['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate the total spending
data['Total_Spending'] = data['MntWines'] + data['MntFruits'] + data['MntMeatProducts'] + data['MntFishProducts'] + data['MntSweetProducts'] + data['MntGoldProds']

# Create a segmented spending analysis plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Marital_Status', y='Total_Spending', data=data, palette='pastel')
plt.title('Customer Spending by Marital Status')
plt.xlabel('Marital Status')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
